en-US.shortDescription: AI household safety agent that reasons about events before acting, not just alerts
en-US.fullDescription: Guardian coordinates Ring, Fire TV, and your household context to understand what's happening at home and decide what to do about it — rather than just forwarding a notification. Tell Guardian to watch the house, ask it to check on a family member, and it will reason about routines, expected visitors, and your safety policies before acting. Guardian never takes an irreversible action without asking first, and never overrides a rule you've set as a hard constraint.
examplePhrases: Guardian, watch the house and help my mother if she needs anything
Guardian, check whether Mom is okay
Guardian, what's the status of the house right now
Guardian, if someone doesn't answer after two attempts, notify me
